data.name: Ajhar
data.long_meaning: This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Ajah' which means 'not born'. The name Ajhar is formed by prefixing the syllable 'Aj' to the root 'Har'. 'Aj' is derived from 'Ajit', a name of Lord Vishnu. 'Har' is derived from 'Hari', a name of Lord Vishnu, symbolizing victory. Thus, Ajhar signifies the victory of Lord Vishnu or Lord Ajit.
